findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body: When a caller supplies another tenant’s document ID, `loadDocument` now queries only by `documentId`, ignoring `ctx.tenantId`. This can return another tenant’s data and breaks the existing tenant-isolation contract. Keep `tenantId` in the query and service call.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body:
`getDocument` now ignores `ctx.tenantId`, and `loadDocument` queries solely by `documentId`. A caller who supplies another tenant’s document ID can retrieve that tenant’s data; duplicate IDs can also return the wrong tenant’s record.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping on document lookups
findings.body:
In a multi-tenant database, a caller who supplies another tenant’s document ID can retrieve that document because `ctx.tenantId` is no longer included in the query, causing cross-tenant data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
